thread:
maria (support): FYI got an escalation from kevin about intermittent 504s on hosted inference streaming calls. customer says it happens ~30s in and occasionally returns 502 instead. X-Request-ID: abc12345
kevin (customer): yes, sending via our SDK -> hosted API streaming embeddings. large metadata blob (~9KB) + long-lived connection. failures started after ~0900 UTC, ~10% of requests. repro attached.
maria (support): can you paste the minimal repro curl?
kevin (customer): here, roughly: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" 
     -H "X-Request-ID: abc12345" 
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
     --data-binary '{"metadata":"<~9KB base64>", "input":"..."}' 
     https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream
```
kevin (customer): if I stream with SDK it keeps the connection open and we see either a 504 gateway timeout after ~30s or a 502 with upstream reset.
maria (support): repro'd locally with the curl above, got a 504 after 31s. grabbed trace id from edge: trace=tr-0f9c
dan (eng-sre): looking at edge logs for trace tr-0f9c -> envoy shows upstream reset: `UPSTREAM_RESET:connection_failure` then upstream_response_code: 502. sample envoy line: `timestamp="2026-02-15T09:12:31Z" method=POST path=/v1/stream resp_code=502 upstream_host=10.2.4.5 cluster=upstream-billing reason=UPSTREAM_RESET`
dan (eng-sre): also seeing auth/billing backend latency spikes around same time (p95 ~3.2s -> occasional 6s). when that times out the proxy tears down the upstream stream and client sees 502/504.
tyler (infra): likely amplifier is large metadata + streaming fanout. edge keeps per-request upstream connections open to multiple services (auth, billing, model-router). large headers push connection count and keepalive pool usage high -> connection queueing -> timeouts.
tyler (infra): short term mitigation: 1) increase envoy idle timeout to 60s for streaming route 2) bump per-host keepalive pool from 8->12 for the hostedapi frontdoor 3) enable 1 retry on 502 for idempotent metadata-only probes (careful for streaming bodies).
tyler (infra): longer term: chunk metadata or compress it. we should also add an explicit metadata size limit enforced at SDK to avoid keeping huge headers.
maria (support): can we get an immediate mitigation we can tell the customer?
tyler (infra): yes — applied canary config to edge-frontdoor in us-west: idle_timeout 60s, upstream_max_connections +50% on that canary. roll looked healthy. will monitor for connection churn.
dan (eng-sre): also triggered a temporary circuit-breaker on the billing cluster to avoid full chain failures; dropping calls to billing after 4s with fallback to cached-billing -> reduces tail.
maria (support): proposed customer workaround: compress metadata and put in body with Content-Encoding: gzip; or split metadata into smaller keys. sample curl: 
```
cat metadata.json | gzip -c | base64 | xargs -0 printf '{"metadata":"%s","input":"..."}' | \n  curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Encoding: gzip" --data-binary @- https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream
```
maria (support): temporary policy for support to send to customers: 1) try that compression workaround 2) if still failing, ask for X-Request-ID and timestamp so we can map to traces 3) we can enable canary edge timeout increase for that tenant for 24h.
kevin (customer): thanks — will try compression + split metadata. can you enable canary for our tenant while we test? :)
tyler (infra): done, tenant kevin-tenant id pinned to canary edge config. watch key: edge/kevin-tenant/canary until 2026-02-16T12:00:00Z.
ops-bot: Canary rollout: edge-frontdoor/us-west -> 10% traffic -> success (no increased error rate for 10m), config id cfg-8791.
dan (eng-sre): added instrumentation to capture metadata-size per-request in edge logs so we can correlate future spikes.
maria (support): I'll reply to kevin with the steps + ask to share results in 2-4 hours. thanks team :thumbsup:
kevin (customer): got it — trying now, will report back soon. thanks!
